description: Tune how a single topic is treated in future briefings: more or less of it, more or less technical, deeper or shorter, more or less often, muted entirely, or followed so every development of that WHOLE THEME gets reported (to follow one specific story, use rate_briefing_entry with "follow" on that entry). This is the precise instrument — for a vague comment like "too much crypto lately" use correct_briefing instead.

topic.description: The topic, as it appears in get_information_diet or in a briefing entry (e.g. "intelligenza artificiale")

name: tune_topic
title: Tune one topic
